title: Battle of Mandora
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Mandora", at revision 1380579496, opens: "The Battle of Mandora was fought on 13 March 1801 between 7,000 French troops under Divisional-general François Lanusse and 13,000 British troops under Lieutenant-general Sir Ralph Abercromby near Alexandria during the French invasion of Egypt and Syria. It was a failed attempt by the French to halt the British advance towards the French-held port of Alexandria." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q4871655, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1801 battle during the French Campaign in Egypt and Syria". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
regionNote: Lane written by the Wikidata import (derived from its own point): this event points at no place record, so the timeline has nothing else to go on.
